text:
kelly: Hey everyone — quick People Ops update: we've set up two dedicated lactation / nursing rooms at SF HQ. Location: 5th floor, Room 5B (next to quiet pods) and a backup on 2nd floor, Room 2A. Booking calendar created: https://calendar.redwood.com/lactation-sf :tada:

hr-bot: Calendar 'Lactation Room - SF' created. Use company SSO to book.

maria: Thank you!! Are there fridges for milk storage?

kelly: Yes — there's a small fridge in Room 5B. Please label milk with name + date. We'll clear it out weekly.

sanjeev: Do we need a keycard? Access after hours?

kelly: Rooms require 5th-floor badge during business hours. If you need after-hours access, request temporary access via this form: https://intra.redwood.com/facilities-access. We'll process same-day for urgent needs.

jamal: Is there a privacy screen and outlet availability? I may need to charge a pump.

kelly: Both rooms have privacy shades, two outlets, a small chair, and a plug adapter in the drawer. There's also a compact changing table. If you need additional equipment (fridge lock, extra chair), DM me.

maria: Any plan for reimbursement if someone needs to travel to SF to use room (for parents visiting from remote hubs)?

kelly: Good Q — we can provide a one-time caregiving travel stipend up to $200 for employees traveling to a Redwood hub to use nursing facilities. To request: email people-ops@redwood.com with trip dates and hub. This is temporary while we expand rooms across hubs.

sanjeev: Can we reserve for >2 hours?

kelly: Booking limited to 2-hour blocks max; you may renew once if there's no queue. The calendar enforces the limit. If you need a standing weekly reservation (e.g., pump schedule), email people-ops and we'll set a recurring slot where possible.

hr-bot: Note: If you need fridge access for refrigerated meds or special storage, contact facilities@redwood.com; we have alternate procedures.

maria: Thanks — super helpful. Appreciate the quick turnaround getting rooms online.

kelly: Quick booking steps:
```:
1) Open company calendar -> 'Lactation Room - SF'
2) Create an event titled 'Lactation — Your Name' and set duration
3) Add people-ops@redwood.com in the guest list if you need after-hours access or a recurring reservation
```
Signage goes up Monday. Ping me with any access hiccups or if we missed something. :heart:
